---
title: "Assignment 02: Google Trends: Two Ways to Get the Same Data"
---

```{r}
library(readxl)
library(tidyverse)

# --- 1. DATA LOADING ---
user_path <- 'C:/Users/ricks/OneDrive/Documents/Graduate/2025 Fall/EPPS 6356 - Data Visualization/Assignment/Assignment 02/HPI_2024_public_dataset.xlsx'

# Hide numeric-parsing warnings from readxl
options(readxl.warn_missing_numeric = FALSE)

# Load Excel quietly
if (file.exists(user_path)) {

  hpi <- suppressWarnings(
    read_excel(user_path, sheet = "All Data", skip = 1)
  )

  message("HPI data loaded successfully from the absolute path.")

} else {

  message("HPI data file not found at the specified path. Proceeding without HPI data.")
  hpi <- NULL
}

## ---- 2. START PLOTTING ------------------------------------------------------

# Setting up a 3x2 plotting grid
par(mfrow = c(3, 2))

# ---- Plot 1 ------------------------------------------------------------
plot(pressure, pch = 16, main = "Pressure vs. Temperature")
text(150, 600,
     "Pressure (mm Hg)\nversus\nTemperature (Celsius)",
     pos = 3, cex = 0.8)

# ---- Plot 2 ------------------------------------------------------------
x_scatter <- c(0.5, 2, 4, 8, 12, 16)
y1 <- c(1, 1.3, 1.9, 3.4, 3.9, 4.8)
y2 <- c(4, .8, .5, .45, .4, .3)

par(las = 1, mar = c(3, 3, 2, 3), cex = .7)
plot(x_scatter, y1, type = "n",
     ylim = c(0, 6), xlim = range(x_scatter),
     axes = FALSE, ann = FALSE)

lines(x_scatter, y1)
lines(x_scatter, y2)
points(x_scatter, y1, pch = 16, cex = 2)
points(x_scatter, y2, pch = 21, bg = "white", cex = 2)

par(col = "gray50", fg = "gray50", col.axis = "gray50")
axis(1, at = seq(0, 16, 4))
axis(2, at = seq(0, 6, 2))
axis(4, at = seq(0, 6, 2))
box(bty = "u")

mtext("Travel Time (s)", side = 1, line = 1.8, cex = 0.7)
mtext("Responses per Travel", side = 2, line = 1.8, las = 0, cex = 0.7)
mtext("Responses per Second", side = 4, line = 1.8, las = 0, cex = 0.7)
text(4, 5, "Bird 131")

par(mar = c(5.1, 4.1, 4.1, 2.1), col = "black", fg = "black",
    col.axis = "black", las = 0, cex = 1)

# ---- Plot 3: Histogram -----------------------------------------------------
Y <- rnorm(50)
Y[Y < -3.5 | Y > 3.5] <- NA

x_norm <- seq(-3.5, 3.5, .1)

par(mar = c(4, 4.1, 3.1, 0))
hist(Y, breaks = seq(-3.5, 3.5),
     ylim = c(0, 0.5), col = "gray80",
     freq = FALSE, main = "Histogram of Normal Data")
lines(x_norm, dnorm(x_norm), lwd = 2)
par(mar = c(5.1, 4.1, 4.1, 2.1))

# ---- Plot 4: Barplot ------------------------------------------------------
par(mar = c(4, 4.1, 3, 2.1))
midpts <- barplot(VADeaths,
                  col = gray(0.1 + seq(1, 9, 2) / 11),
                  names.arg = rep("", 4),
                  main = "Barplot of VADeaths Data")

mtext(sub(" ", "\n", colnames(VADeaths)),
      at = midpts, side = 1, line = 0.5, cex = 0.5)

text(rep(midpts, each = 5),
     apply(VADeaths, 2, cumsum) - VADeaths / 2,
     VADeaths,
     col = rep(c("white", "black"), times = 3:2),
     cex = 0.8)

par(mar = c(5.1, 4.1, 4.1, 2.1))

# ---- Plot 5: Boxplot ------------------------------------------------------
par(mar = c(4, 4.1, 3, 2.1))

boxplot(len ~ dose, data = ToothGrowth,
        boxwex = 0.25, at = 1:3 - 0.2,
        subset = supp == "VC", col = "white",
        xlab = "", ylab = "Tooth Length (mm)",
        ylim = c(0, 35),
        main = "Tooth Growth by Supplement Type and Dose")

mtext("Vitamin C dose (mg)", side = 1, line = 2.5, cex = 0.8)

boxplot(len ~ dose, data = ToothGrowth, add = TRUE,
        boxwex = 0.25, at = 1:3 + 0.2,
        col = "gray90",
        subset = supp == "OJ")

legend(1, 9, c("Ascorbic acid", "Orange juice"),
       fill = c("white", "gray90"),
       bty = "n", cex = 0.8)

par(mar = c(5.1, 4.1, 4.1, 2.1))

# ---- Plot 6: 3D Persp -----------------------------------------------------
x_persp <- seq(-10, 10, length = 30)
y_persp <- x_persp

f <- function(x_p, y_p) {
  r <- sqrt(x_p^2 + y_p^2)
  10 * sin(r) / r
}

z <- outer(x_persp, y_persp, f)
z[is.na(z)] <- 1

par(mar = c(0, 0, 0, 0), lwd = 0.5)

persp(x_persp, y_persp, z,
      theta = 30, phi = 30,
      expand = 0.5, main = "3D Perspective Plot",
      xlab = "X Axis", ylab = "Y Axis", zlab = "Z Axis")

par(mar = c(5.1, 4.1, 4.1, 2.1), lwd = 1)

# ---- Plot 7: Pie Chart ----------------------------------------------------
par(mfrow = c(1, 1), mar = c(0, 2, 3, 2), xpd = FALSE, cex = 1)

pie.sales <- c(0.12, 0.3, 0.26, 0.16, 0.04, 0.12)
names(pie.sales) <- c("Blueberry", "Cherry",
                      "Apple", "Boston Cream",
                      "Other", "Vanilla")

pie(pie.sales,
    col = gray(seq(0.3, 1.0, length = 6)),
    main = "Pie Chart of Sales")

par(mar = c(5.1, 4.1, 4.1, 2.1))

```
